participation.context: Heard the glass, did not hail Sir John, and named a quarter past ten.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Noted the quiet night and took his shoulders for Tuesday.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Turned the glass twice and did not hail Sir John.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Named the Tuesday salting and the loaf, still a penny and still short.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Went out from his pew. He did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

relations.note: the ceiling stayed quiet, and Tuesday is claimed
relations.quote: You did not walk last night.

story.body: You stood through morning prayer and, in the porch, promised your back for the Martinmas stores once the page was done. You did not add a line to the play.

title: Promised Mistress Ansell his back for Tuesday's stores
